name: Hat offset
description: Move the hat relative to the duck’s head. 128 encodes zero offset.

name: Use duck color
description: Replace pure white and gray (157,157,157) in the hat with the selected duck colors.

name: Cape offset
description: Move the cape attachment point.

name: Cape in foreground
description: Draw the cape in front of the duck.

name: Cape sway
description: Adjust cape rotation and weight. Preview uses an approximate cloth simulation.

name: Cape wiggle
description: Adjust how much wind moves the cape.

name: Cape taper · start
description: Width at the cape attachment, normalized from 0 to 1.

name: Cape taper · end
description: Width at the bottom of the cape.

name: Cape alpha · start
description: Opacity at the cape attachment.

name: Cape alpha · end
description: Opacity at the bottom of the cape.

name: Cape as trail
description: Render the cape along the duck’s recent path instead of hanging cloth.

name: Emitter offset
description: Particle spawn position relative to the hat. This preview follows the reference’s signed VEC definition.

name: Particle preset
description: Preset behavior overrides custom particle modifiers. Preview presets are approximations.

name: Emitter shape
description: Choose a point, circle, or box and how particles fill it.

name: Emitter size
description: Size of the emitter shape; preview uses the absolute decoded dimensions.

name: Particle count
description: Particles per quack. G minus 128, clamped to ±8. Negative counts emit nothing.

name: Particle lifespan
description: Time before particles disappear.

name: Particle velocity
description: Initial velocity of the particles.

name: Particle gravity
description: Acceleration applied to particles.

name: Particle friction
description: Velocity multiplier each simulation frame. 255 keeps full velocity.

name: Particle alpha
description: Opacity over the particle’s lifetime.

name: Particle scale
description: Size over the particle’s lifetime.

name: Particle rotation
description: Rotation over the particle’s lifetime. The reference does not specify units; preview uses radians.

name: Particle offset
description: Additional offset for particles.

name: Particles behind duck
description: Render particles behind the duck.

name: Anchor particles
description: Particles follow the hat as the duck moves.

name: Animate particles
description: Animate through the 24 × 24 frames beneath the hat.

name: Loop particle animation
description: Loop the animation instead of stopping on the last frame.

name: Random animation start
description: Start animated particles on a random frame.

name: Particle animation speed
description: Normalized speed, mapped to 0–24 frames per second.

name: Wet lips
description: Changes the game’s quack sound. Export supported; original game audio is not included.

name: Mechanical lips
description: Changes the game’s quack sound. Export supported; original game audio is not included.

name: Randomize X
description: Multiplies the preceding non-randomizer’s decoded parameter(s) by a random value in this range. Order matters. Particle parameters are sampled per spawn.

name: Randomize Y
description: Multiplies the preceding non-randomizer’s decoded parameter(s) by a random value in this range. Order matters. Particle parameters are sampled per spawn.

name: Randomize X + Y
description: Multiplies the preceding non-randomizer’s decoded parameter(s) by a random value in this range. Order matters. Particle parameters are sampled per spawn.
